title: Spring Boot 4.0 bootRun NoClassDefFoundError in DevToolsDataSourceAutoConfiguration: restart classloader hides JDBC classes
errorSample:
Caused by: java.lang.NoClassDefFoundError: org/springframework/boot/jdbc/autoconfigure/DataSourceProperties
	at org.springframework.boot.devtools.autoconfigure.DevToolsDataSourceAutoConfiguration$DevToolsDataSourceCondition.getMatchOutcome(DevToolsDataSourceAutoConfiguration.java:202) ~[spring-boot-devtools-4.0.8.jar:4.0.8]
	at org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.condition.SpringBootCondition.matches(SpringBootCondition.java:47) ~[spring-boot-autoconfigure-4.0.8.jar:4.0.8]
	... 20 common frames omitted
Caused by: java.lang.ClassNotFoundException: org.springframework.boot.jdbc.autoconfigure.DataSourceProperties
	at java.base/jdk.internal.loader.BuiltinClassLoader.loadClass(BuiltinClassLoader.java:641) ~[na:na]
	at java.base/jdk.internal.loader.ClassLoaders$AppClassLoader.loadClass(ClassLoaders.java:188) ~[na:na]
	at java.base/java.lang.ClassLoader.loadClass(ClassLoader.java:526) ~[na:na]
	... 22 common frames omitted
symptom: The application fails to start under bootRun with 'Could not evaluate condition on DevToolsDataSourceAutoConfiguration' and a NoClassDefFoundError for org.springframework.boot.jdbc.autoconfigure.DataSourceProperties, although the project defines its own DataSource bean.
cause: DevTools runs the application inside a separate restart classloader. The auto-configuration condition is evaluated while the restart classloader and the base classloader disagree about which one owns the JDBC classes, so the lookup of DataSourceProperties fails.
fixSummary: Turn off the restart classloader so everything is loaded by a single classloader: set spring.devtools.restart.enabled=false in application.properties (or pass it as a system property to bootRun). The condition is then evaluated normally and the DataSource bean is picked up without errors.
